posts.name: Shashwat
posts.cooked:
After release of NPPE, I am facing this issue from that time. I dont know by whom it got reset, as ip address is different.

Please forward this message to the ones who can solve this backend issue,
or guide me if it’s from my side.

Thank you

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Can you try a few things:

  • Re-upload your ssh key to the course VM website ( dont have to regenerate )
  • Try with mobile data

The server is up and running as expected.

posts.name: Shashwat
posts.cooked: Tried submitting the public key again, but still shows key_exchange_identification: Connection reset by peer

posts.name: Shashwat
posts.cooked: Today is the last date of NPPE, so can anyone please try to help as soon as possible

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: I would suggest joining the OPPE support session at 9 pm and get your issue fixed.

posts.name: Shashwat
posts.cooked:
So the solution i got from this is to remove the known_hosts from .ssh directory, and then again generate a new SSH key (ssh-keygen). And then do the normal process of VM access (paste the .pub key in the website) and then try to login into the se2001 or sc-oppe.
Don’t all the answers will be saved, and nothing will happen to them.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Yes, your scripts will remain as is.
